description: CalibrationFitReport (plans/WP4-calibration-lifecycle-shared_contract.md s5-s7): the fit panel classification, entry-time checks, the camera anchor and capture. Expected numbers from PROJ (pyproj) + numpy. Generated by scripts/gen_calibration_fixtures.py, never hand edited.

rules.points: page = raw pdf user space (y up, /Rotate ignored). reference is what the parser gives (calibration_input.json): grid {zone, south, easting, northing (SW corner), cellSizeM, source} or geographic {lat, lon}; kind feature adds cellSizeM/2 to E and N for cells over 1 m. geographic is sheet datum unless datumOverride WGS84 (GPS): then datum.fromWGS84
rules.planeZone: zone + hemisphere of the LOWEST-numbered point: its grid zone if typed as grid, else floor((lon+180)/6)+1 clamped to 1..60 (lon 180 -> 60) and lat < 0 (no Norway/Svalbard exceptions). A grid point in that zone is used as is, everything else goes lat/lon -> TM forward on the sheet ellipsoid. A point more than 90 deg of longitude from the plane CM can't be forwarded
rules.fit: least squares page -> plane affine [a,b,c,d,e,f] (X = a x + b y + c), the WP1 fitter. residual = plane distance, RMS = sqrt(sum r^2 / n). D = longer pageBox diagonal mapped through the fit (plane metres), tau = max(10, 0.0005 D)
rules.blocked: n >= 3, in this order: degenerate (page eigen ratio < 0.02, the fitter refuses, no fit); invalid (a point can't be forwarded, the fit isn't finite or |det L| == 0, or a pageBox corner's toWGS84 is nil / non-finite / |lat| > 85); implausible (anisotropy = sigma_max / sigma_min of L > 1.5, or scaleDenominator = sqrt|det L| / (0.0254/72) outside 1,000 - 5,000,000). Contract s6.3 (amended r1) has the same order: invalid can't be evaluated without the fit WP1 refuses for a degenerate set, so degenerate goes first (d2_10_collar_zone_typo_still_degenerate pins it). Fit numbers are reported whenever a fit exists, grade/issue/rowStatus only when not blocked
rules.grade: n >= 4: good (RMS <= tau), fair (<= 3 tau), poor. n = 3: exact (grade null)
rules.leaveOneOut: looRmsM[k] = RMS of the fit without k on its own points, looM[k] = k's distance to that fit; null when the others are < 3 or degenerate
rules.issue: n >= 5 and RMS > tau: S = {k : looRms_k <= tau}; |S| = 1 outlier {number, distanceM = looM}; |S| >= 2 ambiguous {first, second} = the two smallest looRms, smaller first, ties to the lower number; |S| = 0 disagree {maxResidualM}. n = 4 and RMS > tau: disagreeAddFifth {maxResidualM}. flagged = [outlier number]
rules.rowStatus: points sheet glyph per point when graded: error (> 3 tau or flagged), warn (> tau), ok
rules.spread: n >= 3: points' page bbox narrower than 0.25 of the pageBox width or shorter than 0.25 of its height
rules.nextCorner: while n < 3 or spreadLow: pageBox corners as VIEWED after /Rotate (rotate 90: viewed top-left is raw bottom-left), each moved 10% of the way to the opposite corner; pick the one with the largest minimum page distance to the points; ties go top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. nextCornerPage is that inset point in raw page space
rules.finish: blocked {reason: needMore (needMore = 3 - n) | degenerate | invalid | implausible}, else confirm {reasons in order exact, poor, outlier|ambiguous, spreadLow}, else ready
rules.primaryStatus: panel line 1 without the camera-dependent calibration_off_sheet: intro (n = 0), blocked reason, issue, exact fit text (n = 3) or fit summary, need points (n < 3). Distances/RMS args are metres (DisplayFormat.distance), points args are counts for the calibration_point plural, grade is the calibration_grade_* key
rules.entryChecks: predictor: (1) editing k with >= 3 other points that aren't degenerate: their fit, h = x0'(A'A)^-1 x0 over the other points' [x y 1] rows; (2) n >= 3 and not blocked: the current fit, h over all current points; (3) base georef that isn't provisional: the base, h = 0, tau from the WGS84 geodesic length of the pageBox diagonals through it; (4) none. d = WGS84 geodesic between predictor.toWGS84(page) and the typed reference (resolved, toWGS84). warn when d > max(3 tau sqrt(1+h), 50)
rules.cameraAnchor: p = old.toPage(camera); centre = new.toWGS84(p); s(g) = sqrt|det J|, J = d(web mercator zoom-0 256-unit world of g.toWGS84)/d(page) by central differences, h = 1 pt; zoom = clamp(zoom + log2(s_old(p)/s_new(p)), 2, 22); heading unchanged
rules.capture: page = georef.toPage(camera centre); onSheet = inside the pageBox (edges count); screenPtPerPagePt = 2^zoom * s(georef) at that page point; zoomHint when < 1
rules.provisional: provisionalInputs: PdfGeoreference.provisional(pageBox, rotate, centre) = geographic WGS84, 1 pt = 50000 * 0.0254/72 m east and north at the centre latitude (WGS84 radii), rotated by -rotate about the box centre, centre lat clamped to +-80

rmsDisplay.rule: OD-F12: the {rms} arg of calibration_fit_summary, calibration_done, calibration_finish_confirm_poor and map_state_calibrated. rmsM < 9.95: one decimal + ' m' (DisplayFormat.number, 1 decimal, locale decimal separator), else DisplayFormat.distance. Other distances (outlier, disagree, warn_far, residual rows) stay DisplayFormat.distance

cases.note: no points: intro text, every corner ties at +inf, so top-left
one point near the top-left, the farthest inset corner is bottom-right
two points, top-right is clearly the emptiest corner
D2-03: 1:50k UTM sheet at 45 N (zone 32), three corner intersections: exact fit, no grade, Finish asks first. holdOut is the 4th corner, must be under 1 m
D2-03 with the 4th corner: Good, ready
6 points, 0.5 pt placement noise, 10 m scan warp, point 6 is a feature: Good, no outlier named (rule 6.4 only looks when RMS > tau)
point 3 typed 1 km east: n = 4 can't say which, Poor + 'add a 5th point'
4 corners + centre, point 2 (top-right) 1 km off. Dropping 2 OR its opposite corner 4 leaves a set the affine fits, so it's 'point 2 or 4', smaller leave-one-out RMS first
6 points, point 4 typed 1 km east: named
points 2 and 5 both 1 km off: no single point fixes it, 'disagree', Poor
a 86 m smooth scan warp: Fair, every leave-one-out is still worse than tau so 'disagree', and neither Fair nor disagree asks before Finish
point 3 typed in zone 2 instead of 32 (a dropped digit): its lat/lon is 180 deg from the zone 32 CM, it can't be forwarded into the plane: invalid
point 3's column letter one off (100 km east): the exact 3-point fit is wildly stretched, implausible (anisotropy)
the same reference typed for three spread points: the page -> plane map is singular, invalid
a 1:500 site plan: the fit is fine but the scale is outside 1:1,000-1:5,000,000
D2-10, same inputs as pdf_georef.json fiduciaryFits near_collinear_d2_10: three taps along the bottom collar, eigen ratio ~1e-5

the same collar with point 3 also in the wrong zone: degenerate is checked first (it's a property of the page points, WP1's fitter refuses before fitting), so the user is told to spread the points, not to check zones
4 good points bunched in the bottom-left fifth of the sheet: Good, but spread is low so Finish asks and the next-corner hint points top-right
3 clustered points: both exact and spreadLow, in that order

ED50 sheet (D2-05): MGRS/UTM typed in ED50, point 4 is a GPS fix (WGS84, datumOverride) that goes through ED50 fromWGS84 first. checks[] has 32U NA 00000 40000 against PROJ's EPSG:23032 truth (under 5 m)
GDA94 sheet drawn in zone 55 across 150 E; point 2 is typed in zone 56 and goes through lat/lon into the zone 55 plane (point 1's zone)
same points with point 1 deleted: numbers keep their gap, and the plane zone is now point 2's typed zone 56 (lowest remaining number)
lowest point is lat/lon: zone floor((lon+180)/6)+1 = 55, south from the sign of lat (fiduciaryFits cbr50k_plain_latlon_first)
pdf_georef.json fiduciaryFits sf_plain_typo_outlier (index 2 = point 3, 300 m typo): rule 6.4 names point 3, same as flaggedOutliers [2]
/Rotate 90 page, no points: top-left AS VIEWED is the raw bottom-left corner
/Rotate 90, one point near the raw bottom-left (viewed top-left): next is the viewed bottom-right
A2/B1: point 1 is lat/lon at exactly 180 E (Fiji). floor((180+180)/6)+1 = 61 isn't a zone: clamped to 60, the fit works, nothing is blocked
A2/B1: the same at exactly 180 W: zone 1, points east of it
sf sheet as a GeoPDF, nothing placed yet

entryChecks.note: 4th point typed right: predicted by the exact 3-point fit with its leverage, no warning
4th point with a 1 km northing slip: warns, Save becomes Save anyway
editing point 2 with the right figures: predicted by the other 3 points' fit (leverage of point 2 against them)
editing point 2 with a 300 m slip: warns
editing point 1 of 3: the other two can't make a fit, so the current fit predicts (h = 1 for an exact fit)
refining a GeoPDF with no points: the embedded georef predicts, h = 0, tau from the page box diagonals (WGS84 geodesic through the base)
same with a 1 km easting slip: warns
2 points on a provisional placement: nothing to predict with, no check
3 collinear points (blocked) on a provisional placement: no check

cameraAnchor.note: first refit: provisional 1:50k guess -> the 3-point fit. The page point under the crosshair stays, zoom moves by log2 of the scale ratio, heading untouched
4th point refines the fit: tiny move
/Rotate 90 page: the provisional placement is upright as viewed, the real georef is the rot90 sheet's own
provisional 1:50k -> the real 1:25k sheet adds ~1 zoom level from 21.75: clamped to 22

capture.note: crosshair on the sheet at z16: 1 page pt is several screen pt, no hint
same spot at z12: 1 page pt < 1 screen pt, the hint shows (it doesn't block)
crosshair left of the page box: Add point disabled
